title: Whisper-Onchain
tagline: Anonymous feedback board on blockchain. Submit, vote, and verify—all transparent & on-chain.
description: WhisperOnChain is a decentralized anonymous feedback platform built on Ethereum. Users submit feedback in three categories (Positive, Constructive, Ideas) without revealing their identity while maintaining complete transparency through smart contracts. The platform includes a community voting system where users can upvote/downvote feedback to surface quality content. All feedback and votes are stored on-chain with timestamps, creating an immutable record. Contract owners can moderate content when necessary, with all moderation actions logged transparently. The system supports real-time statistics, filtering by category, and pagination for efficient data retrieval.
how_its_made: The platform uses Ethereum smart contracts written in Solidity for core functionality including feedback submission, voting, and moderation. The frontend is built with Next.js and integrates wallet connectivity through RainbowKit. Users interact with the blockchain through their wallets to submit anonymous feedback while maintaining verifiable authenticity. The smart contract enforces validation rules like character limits and prevents duplicate voting. All data is stored on-chain ensuring transparency and immutability, while the decentralized architecture eliminates single points of failure or censorship.
